title: Sinéad Clarkin (former GE FastWorks, The Lean Startup Company) — 'The idea of building organisations that stay true to their purpose, especially under pressure, feels more important than ever'
summary: Sinéad Clarkin — Lean Startup Company alum who first put the methodology into practice with the GE FastWorks team — posts a four-paragraph reflection on starting Incorruptible, naming Eric's earlier work as the thing that 'genuinely changed the direction of my career' and connecting Incorruptible to her ongoing work on cultural transformation.
blockquote: The idea of building organisations that stay true to their purpose, especially under pressure, feels more important than ever.
attribution_title: Founder, Clarkin Consulting; previously The Lean Startup Company and GE FastWorks team
